1y3n94f.text: Your five ZEC is in. Good work. Go treat yourself.

oykhav.text: Now that's worth getting up for.

1xbp928.text: Our five-ZEC friend just bought noodles. Plaza kiosk. People are so generous with their secrets.

11e995d.text: Five ZEC, sitting on a public address near Ave & 4th, waiting like an open door. Go collect.

16tqnc3.text: There you are. Five ZEC, and you went straight for noodles. Nice.

1if5qc.text: Still here? Five ZEC in your pocket, and nowhere to hide. Nice.

udf5s4.text: Well. That was hard to watch. Even for me, and I've watched this city a long time.

1htlwr9.text: You were paid in a city made of glass, and your first instinct was to hold the money up to the light.

13ck8e1.text: Address. Amount. Time. Place. You handed them a *map*, then acted surprised when they read it.

87kobt.text: I'm not angry. It happens to ten thousand people a night. You just happen to be the one I've decided to help.

fpbil9.text: Call me *Zero*. That's exactly how much they'll know about you when we're done. Let's start the night again.

1veho5g.text: Same night. Same rain. Same people watching. The only thing that changed is you.

18nwdr4.text: Before that money lands, you need a real wallet. Open it. I'll be right here.

ypl4zq.text: Twenty-four words. Your whole fortune, in a language thieves would kill to read. Never let anyone read it. Not me. Especially not people who ask nicely.

ygbplv.text: Strange. I have the oddest feeling we have done this before.

nox9ff.text: Fresh money on the public ledger. *Five ZEC*, Ave & 4th. Someone just lit a candle in a dark room.

1rtr501.text: And there it is. Five ZEC on a transparent address, glowing like a lighthouse. That's how they found you last time. Open the wallet and hold SHIELD. Let's turn the lights off.

am30nb.text: ...Gone. Five ZEC slipped into the shielded pool, and the pool doesn't gossip. Pity.

1grk94v.text: Watch the exits. Everything that goes in comes out eventually, and people are such creatures of habit.

1hc17rh.text: Feel that? Every eye in this city just lost focus at the same time. Delicious.

1cxt8gs.text: Better. Now live. Coffee at Nullstate. Mika owes you at the arcade. Rent at Cobalt, and Cobalt only takes public money, so tread lightly there. This city adores a pattern.

ns7q0y.text: Noodles? *0.3 ZEC*. Just send it to my address.

gh4f3k.text: Not now, you're lit up like a billboard. Shield first, then come talk to me.

1i3jnsi.text: Welcome to Nullstate. Shielded payments only. We don't keep a glass register.

elytae.text: Coffee is *0.02 ZEC*. Leave a note in the memo if you like. Only I can read it.

1qr0zop.text: There you are! I owe you *0.5 ZEC* for the pizza.

hj37p1.text: Show me your address and I'll send it.

ec8q2k.text: Cobalt Exchange. Rent, cash-outs, anything that needs to be public.

yresu9.text: Your rent is *1.20 ZEC*, paid to our transparent address. Want to cash out anything else while you're here?

1qvn4iu.text: Psst. Got coins on another chain? I swap them straight into *shielded* ZEC.

te68rn.text: Fresh coins that never touched the glass. The real Zodl app does this with its Swap button.

1sh4olp.text: Nice hood. Seen a fella with five ZEC? No? Didn't think so.

17k5gk0.text: Evening. Nice night to be... visible.

197pc0r.text: Got it. I can read your private note. Coffee is on the counter.

1hqdxia.text: Got it. Coffee's on the counter.

1mxvbr8.text: On the public chain that payment is just a blur. No amount, no names.

1qvrzjw.text: A note only one person alive can read. Romantic, really. The ledger saw a payment happen and learned nothing else.

1kkotgi.text: Pool exit. Almost exactly what went in, and barely any time later. Hardly anyone else left the pool in that window.

1q7bsk7.text: Same money, barely rinsed. Our ghost is standing at Cobalt, admiring the view. Go.

1tse6xv.text: Rent received. Have a good night.

dbi44a.text: Another pool exit to Cobalt. Plenty of exits tonight, and none of them look like our five. Could be anyone. I hate anyone.

xr8abk.text: Small. Late. Different. Three words that keep people whole in this city. Well done.

15054pp.text: Hm, that's your *transparent* address. If I pay that, the whole city sees it on the ledger, and the Tailors get your address again.

b2b2xe.text: Got a shielded one? Starts with *u1*.

1qjwqa0.text: Only you can read the note. To everyone else it's just... nothing happened. Love that.

11tpc1d.text: Money arrived and nobody noticed. That's the trick. Not invisibility. Indifference.

jfbz7g.text: Pleasure. The coins you swapped FROM are still public on their own chain, remember that.

ip59mq.text: Sun's up. Tell me something about our five-ZEC ghost.

132x948.text: An address that went quiet at 18:14. That's all? ...Close the file. I despise a blank page.

yl5z34.text: They hunted you all night and found a ghost. How does it feel to be nobody?

zf4fz8.text: You were never hiding. Hiding is for the guilty. You were simply *private*. Like a sealed letter. Like a closed door.

15yzfrt.text: Everything you did tonight works the same in a real wallet. Same buttons. Same silence. Go on, the real city is waiting.

qalq.text: Five went in, five came out. You might as well have signed it. Again. Only the rent this time.

1cpsxve.text: Dawn's coming. Go home. The Tailors are holding an empty file, and it's driving them mad.

176iaga.text: Don't stare at them. Staring is a pattern too.

10ngty1.text: Running draws eyes. You're private, not prey. Walk.

ilzbt2.text: Look up. That's the real Zcash network, breathing. Notice how much of it simply isn't there.
